title: Armijo-Constrained Gradient from Round-2 Best
scientific_hypothesis: Score regression in rounds 3-4 resulted from unconstrained step sizes causing optimizer overshoot; enforcing per-layer thickness delta ≤20 nm with Armijo backtracking will recover and exceed round-2 performance (0.9968) by maintaining monotonic improvement.
design_principle: Constrained gradient descent with adaptive step-size control prevents destructive large updates while preserving the verified 12-layer alternating topology's dual-band capability.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (12 finite layers, alternating high-low index starting with Ta2O5)
design_variables: layer thicknesses (12 variables, bounded 20-400 nm, per-iteration delta ≤20 nm)
manufacturing_considerations: per-iteration change limit improves process control
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Gradient descent with Armijo line search for bounded optimization
Thin-film interference principle for dual-band AR
expected_advantages: Monotonic improvement guarantee via Armijo backtracking
Prevents destructive large steps that caused round-4 regression
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as round-2
20 nm delta cap may slow convergence if larger steps needed
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 antireflection stack on silicon substrate for normal-incidence unpolarized illumination. Initialize thicknesses from round-2 best candidate: [279.86, 333.36, 189.54, 169.66, 155.71, 212.57, 59.58, 179.54, 127.69, 296.17, 296.15, 332.07] nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with hard per-layer delta constraint ≤20 nm per iteration. Activate Armijo backtracking when projected figure-of-merit improvement is <0.5% or negative. Bounds: 20-400 nm per layer. Minimize mean reflectance across 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm, and run_status. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: Armijo backtracking + 20 nm delta cap + warm-start from round-2 best thicknesses to address score regression in rounds 3-4
